text:
Our answers are not opposite. Ana said that the ETA-IL is valid for 2 years which is correct, but ETA-IL is a travel authorization which has nothing to do with entry rights to Israel (which is what I was talking about). 

Now, you added new information in the comment that you and your husband are actually in an active partner visa process (kudos to Anja for asking, because your post said nothing about that). 
I think you need to clarify what your situation is exactly, because you also wrote "resubmit" an application which makes no sense. We can't help with half information, you will get bad advise if you don't share the full picture.
